cs: QTC výplaty jsou dočasně pozastavené (deferred), dokud nebude funded payout treasury — ledger je zachován, vyplatí se FIFO po funding. ZION a PRL výplaty jedou normálně. Detail v FAQ.
en: QTC payouts are temporarily deferred until the payout treasury is funded — the ledger is retained and will settle FIFO after funding. ZION and PRL payouts run normally. Details in the FAQ.
